description:
Portfolio Finance – Execution Business Officer, VP

Onsite: Boston, MA

 

Who we are looking for

The Execution, Financing & Clearing Portfolio Finance team supports our Agency Lending, Prime Services, Secured Financing and Execution businesses with a focus on portfolio analytics, revenue & resource optimization and market insights. We serve at the intersection of data, reporting and scenario analysis to deliver actionable intelligence that improves decision making.

 

Why this role is important to us

The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Markets (SSM). When owners and managers of institutional assets need research, trading, securities lending and innovative portfolio strategies, they turn to the SSM business unit. As our investment research and trading arm, SSM’s number one goal is to enhance and preserve our clients’ portfolio values by applying technology, optimizing trading, and linking asset classes and markets across the world. Join us if making your mark in the capital markets industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

 

What you will be responsible for

Serve as strategic advisor to the Execution business owners, working closely with executive leaders and supporting functions to drive strategy, growth, profitability and market expansion

Develop a deep understanding of business drivers, including revenue, expense & balance sheet attributions

Oversee quarterly and annual financial planning in collaboration with Markets CFO and Investor Relations

Empower Client Management and Trading with portfolio analytics, scenario analysis and optimization tools in collaboration with Portfolio Finance quantitative leads

Create in-depth market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities, trends, and challenges

 

What we value

A dynamic problem solver – consistently utilizes a solution driven mindset

A trusted advisor with the tenacity and business acumen to provide thought leadership and deliver positive commercial outcomes in both the short and long-

Ambitious and driven to deliver business strategy transformation informed by expertise in market and competitor trends

Detail oriented – understands the nuances that can impact overall outcomes

A strong influencer and thoughtful communicator who can express complex ideas in simple, practical terms

Ability to learn quickly, juggle multiple projects, and work autonomously

Entrepreneurial and self-directed – operates as an owner

 

Education & Preferred Qualifications

8+ years of experience in Financial Services or Management Consulting required

Comfortability with modern data management tools (e.g., Databricks)

Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools

$170,000 - $173,750 Annual

State Street Investment Management is seeking a senior investment leader to serve as Head of Portfolio Management, United States, Systematic Equity. This position reports directly to the Chief Investment Officer of Systematic Equity.

Portfolio Management Leadership

Lead the U.S. Systematic Equity portfolio management team, ensuring disciplined execution of investment strategies.

Oversee portfolio construction, implementation, monitoring, and adherence to client guidelines and investment objectives.

Ensure alignment with global investment frameworks and best practices.

Act as the senior escalation point for portfolio management and implementation issues.

Client & Commercial Engagement

Serve as a senior investment representative with institutional clients, prospects, and consultants.

Partner with Client Coverage and Product teams to support new business, retention, and mandate development.

Clearly articulate investment philosophy, process, performance, and risk management to clients.

Contribute to thought leadership and client-facing activities to strengthen Systematic Equity’s market position.

Product Development & Growth

Drive development of new Systematic Equity products and enhancement of existing strategies.

Translate client needs and market opportunities into commercially viable solutions.

Support sales growth and asset raising through product positioning and investment expertise.

Risk, Compliance & Governance

Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Operations to ensure adherence to regulatory and internal requirements.

Monitor investment, operational, and implementation risks, ensuring timely escalation and resolution.

Participate in governance forums and investment oversight processes.

Process Improvement & Innovation

Enhance efficiency, scalability, and consistency of the portfolio management operating model across all strategies – active and index.

Drive process improvements, automation, and adoption of advanced tools and analytics.

Partner with Systematic Equity CIO, Head of EMEA & APAC Portfolio Management, Technology, Trading, and Operations to streamline workflows and improve execution, while developing new / improved operating model.

Talent & Organizational Leadership

Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing portfolio management team.

Foster a collaborative, accountable, and performance-driven culture.

Support career development, succession planning, and capability building.

Financial Management

Manage budgets, resourcing, and cost discipline for the portfolio management function.

Support profitability of strategies through operational efficiency and scalable processes.

Align resource allocation with long-term business and growth priorities.

What We Value

Strong systematic/quantitative equity investment expertise

Proven leadership of portfolio management teams

Commercial mindset with client-facing credibility

Deep understanding of portfolio construction, risk, and implementation

Ability to drive operational improvements and scalable processes

Strong judgment in regulated environments

Collaborative, results-oriented leadership style

Education & Experience

15–20+ years in investment management, preferably systematic or quantitative equity

Leadership experience in portfolio management or investment teams

Demonstrated success in client engagement and product development

Solid understanding of U.S. institutional markets

CFA, MBA, or equivalent strongly preferred

title: Director, Program Management
Director, Technical Program Management
description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, United States

Overview

GitHub is looking for a director to help lead GitHub’s Technical Program Management team in our Engineering organization. You should be an ambitious, passionate, technical, and collaborative leader with a strong background in empowering high performing teams and an ability to deliver results through technical programs. 


The Director, TPM will strengthen TPM's role as a trusted integrator, driving clarity, accountability, and execution across complex, cross-functional initiatives. They will help teams frame problems, align stakeholders, and accelerate decision-making while raising the effectiveness of TPMs and scaling their influence across the company. This director will foster a culture of ownership, bias for action, and operational excellence, ensuring execution remains tightly aligned with strategic priorities. 


Responsibilities

Opportunity and Solutions Identification 

  • Demonstrates and builds experiences across multiple groups or divisions. Leads and coaches teams to develop problem statements and form hypotheses for products and services across divisional boundaries to address highly complex business, program, customer needs, and/or market opportunities; identifies dependencies of other features. 

  • Determines and leads process improvements to quickly scope insights, and drives change management initiatives. Uses industry understanding to direct teams to ensure alignment between the customer, the market, internal stakeholders, senior leadership, and the goals and strategy of GitHub. 

  • Holds teams accountable for collaborating with others (e.g., Engineering, Marketing, Design) to ensure that they can satisfy customer requirements. Provides expertise to help teams validate the market size and opportunity of greatest value for the company. Facilitates collaboration between their team and other partner teams to bring about solutions. 

 

Program Planning and Success 

  • Provides expertise to help teams define the multiple program goals and prioritization for the products and services they own. Guides teams to translate the needs of the organization and other teams into program goals and prioritize deliverables based on data insights.  

  • Guides teams to engage in active risk management (proactive and reactive) to identify risks and propose mitigations for risks using data (e.g., telemetry, usage, net satisfaction, customer satisfaction). 

  • Coaches teams to define success criteria and performance metrics (e.g., Objectives and Key Results [OKRs], Key Performance Indicators [KPIs] such as quality and performance) of products, services and works with engineering to ensure needed telemetry is developed. Provides expert knowledge to help teams deeply understand the return on investment. 

  

Program/Service Development 

  • Acts as a subject matter expert in orchestrating and integrating efforts for the development and implementation process of product, services on large cross functional projects with internal teams and external partners. Drives teams to collaborate and coordinate across teams and perspectives to ensure alignment on product management and release, including tradeoffs, adjustments, and improvements as feasible. 

  • Guides teams to partner with the engineering team to contribute, prioritize, and deliver on the roadmap for product, service. Drives teams to understand the value proposition for the feature(s)/feature areas and answer technical questions on the feature(s)/feature areas they own.  

  • Guides teams to justify capacity requirements and advocate for the right resource allocation. Partners with the Engineering team to know the feature capabilities in alignment with the goal updates and associated tradeoffs. 

  • Guides teams tracking, coordinating, and communicating end-to-end project schedules for products, services. Ensures teams establish and monitor processes, and hold other stakeholders accountable for following the established schedule and processes. 

  • Guides teams when tracking and managing dependencies to enable cohesive, connected user scenarios, and to avoid issues and mitigate risks. Coaches teams to make adjustments or course corrections when projects are not aligned to schedules or goals. 

  • Drives teams to develop the staging and implementation plan for piloting/release in alignment with Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for products, services, its development timeline, and the introduction to the different programs. Ensures teams collaborate with stakeholders to monitor progress and adjust as needed. 

  • Helps teams lead governance programs and processes to ensure that specific performance requirements and standards are met throughout the development lifecycle (e.g., quality, compliance, privacy, security, safety, accessibility). 

 

Continuous Improvement 

  • Provides expertise to help teams partner with others to collect performance metrics (e.g., Key Performance Indicators [KPIs] such as usage, quality, speed, and cost), monitor and report on progress (e.g., business reviews), and derive insights that lead to productive courses of action. 

  • Ensures teams share insights with Engineering and other partners. Leads teams to form hypotheses to technical needs, perform experiments, and iterate to drive improvement in specific performance metrics that have measurable impact. 


Qualifications

Required Qualifications 

  • 8+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 6+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 4+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years experience in managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • 10+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 10+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 8+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR Doctorate in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 6+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years people management experience.
  • 4+ years experience designing, building, or supporting software systems. 

Compensation Range

The base salary range for this job is USD $140,400.00 - USD $372,300.00 /Yr.

These pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the United States. An individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant. At GitHub certain roles are eligible for benefits and additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. These rewards are allocated based on individual impact in role. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee's role.

This position will be open for a minimum of 3 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

GitHub values

  • Customer-obsessed
  • Ship to learn
  • Growth mindset
  • Own the outcome
  • Better together
  • Diverse and inclusive

Manager fundamentals

  • Model
  • Coach
  • Care

Leadership principles

  • Create clarity
  • Generate energy
  • Deliver success

Who We Are

GitHub is the world’s leading AI-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.
Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
Join us, and let’s change the world, together.

EEO Statement

GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences. Also, if you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

title: Staff Software Engineer,  Pull Request Platform
description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, United States

Overview

GitHub's Pull Request Platform powers one of the most critical developer workflows in the world. Every pull request operation across GitHub.com, the API, and GitHub Enterprise Server depends on the systems this team owns. The team is responsible for pull request state, mergeability, indexing, automation, and platform reliability, serving tens of millions of developers who collaborate, review code, and ship software every day. 

 

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help lead Pull Request Platform through a period of significant technical investment. The team is strengthening production reliability in a complex, high-traffic area, contributing to GitHub's service-extraction efforts, and evolving its infrastructure to meet growing scale requirements. You'll join our Core Productivity organization and directly influence the reliability and performance of one of GitHub's most visible and heavily used features. 

 

As a staff engineer, you'll be a hands-on technical leader who shapes architecture, guides complex initiatives, and helps the team turn ambiguous problems into durable solutions. You'll work across Git operations, databases, search, APIs, and asynchronous workflows while helping define the platform's longer-term technical direction. 

 

This work blends distributed systems experience with pragmatic execution — moving between writing and reviewing code, leading architectural decisions, improving production systems, and building alignment across organizational boundaries. You'll partner closely with Pull Request Experience, Repositories Platform, Git Systems, and other teams across GitHub while mentoring engineers and helping the team grow its technical practices.

In this role, you will act as a known subject matter expert and trusted ambassador who engages with security researchers, open source maintainers, and enterprise developers and encourages them to get the most out of GitHub Security Lab's security tools and resources — including CodeQL, Dependabot, secret scanning, code scanning, Copilot Autofix, AI-powered vulnerability detection, and the GitHub Advisory Database.

You will also help the security community understand and navigate the evolving intersection of AI and security — from securing AI-generated code to leveraging AI for vulnerability discovery.


As a Staff-level advocate, you bring cross-team influence and deep technical expertise across multiple areas. You don't just execute — you set direction, establish frameworks that help others produce great security content, and proactively identify highly impactful unaddressed issues, mobilizing resources to resolve them before they affect the community. You mentor and sponsor others within the team, and you use data and business outcomes to inform decisions and influence stakeholders across GitHub.


Responsibilities

Understanding the Security Community

Acts as a known subject matter expert of the security research and open source developer communities — their common experiences, goals, industry trends, and key developments — by meeting with community members, attending security and developer conferences, and engaging on social media. Possesses expert knowledge of GitHub's security products and services (CodeQL, code scanning, secret scanning, Dependabot, advisory database) and their potential impact on the broader security ecosystem. Strategically seeks out influencers in the security and open source spaces to understand business drivers and community objectives. Anticipates future changes in the application security landscape, including the impact of AI on security research workflows and the emerging challenges of securing AI-generated code.

Building Trusted Relationships

Acts as a trusted and influential ambassador between the security community and GitHub's product, engineering, and marketing teams. Builds and maintains a broad, diverse network across security researchers, open source maintainers, and enterprise security teams. Utilizes deep understanding of community needs to share valuable insights, best practices, and technical know-how, maintaining thought leadership within the security community.

Internal Advocacy and Impact

Collects and seeks out feedback from the security community and stakeholders regarding product usage, user experience, and technical issues. Ensures the feedback loop between community members, the Security Lab, and the GitHub product team is effective.

Supporting Key Internal Initiatives

Acts as a subject matter expert for internal stakeholders on application security and the security researcher community. Regularly engages in retrospective evaluations to inform future work.

Content Development

Defines, creates, and leads the technical content strategy for the Security Lab — blog posts, tutorials, training courses, videos, CTFs, puzzles, and conference talks — covering topics from traditional vulnerability research to AI-assisted security analysis and secure AI development practices. Drives interactions across technical forums, social media, and community channels to promote awareness and provide best practices. CX Vision and Strategy

This leader will be responsible for four pillars of creating the world's best Customer Experience engine for the world's most advanced unstructured robotic solutions:

Pillar I: CX Product Innovation & Customer Obsession

Product Leadership: Directly manage one Product Manager to productize the end-to-end customer journey with the same rigor as hardware development.

Zero-Friction Mandate: Drive the strategy for "zero friction" scores by translating customer obsession into actionable product requirements and seamless onboarding experiences.

Pillar II: Portfolio & Technical Program Delivery

TPM Management: Lead and mentor a team of three Technical Program Managers (TPMs) to oversee the execution of the CX strategic roadmap.

Serviceability & Scale: Focus the TPM team on maturing legacy systems, improving serviceability, and deploying introspective tooling that enables the CX organization to scale globally.

Pillar III: Strategic CX Integration & Alignment

Executive Partnership: Serve as the primary strategic partner to the VP of Customer Experience, translating high-level vision into actionable, enterprise-wide strategy.

Cross-Functional Synergy: Drive organizational alignment across departmental silos, managing stakeholder relationships to ensure unified outcomes across the entire CX lifecycle.

Pillar IV: Rapid Prototyping & AI/Enterprise Tooling

Dev Team Leadership: Manage a small, dedicated scrum team of developers to rapidly prototype internal tools and advanced CX capabilities.

Tooling Ownership: Own the incubation and iteration of AI initiatives and enterprise tools (e.g., Salesforce) through to the point of handover to the BizOps team.

BizOps Collaboration: Partner closely with BizOps Data Science and BizOps PMO teams to ensure technical prototypes are scalable and data-driven before full enterprise integration.

Qualifications & Key Attributes

Experience: 15+ years of leadership experience in Product Management, Portfolio/Program Management, or CS Strategy, ideally within a scaling B2B technology, hardware, or robotics company.

Methodology Mastery: Deep fluency in product management methodologies (Agile, journey mapping, discovery frameworks) and portfolio management best practices (governance, resource leveling, strategic road mapping).

Systems Architecture & Scaling: A proven track record of taking immature operational processes and scaling them into robust, enterprise-grade systems capable of supporting complex, global deployments.

Change Management Expertise: Demonstrated experience leading large-scale organizational change (e.g., ADKAR or similar frameworks). Excellence in bringing disparate stakeholders together and leading through influence without direct authority.

Customer Obsession & Analytics: A relentless drive to advocate for the user, coupled with the analytical acumen to translate qualitative feedback and quantitative metrics into actionable product requirements.

Exceptional Communication: The ability to seamlessly translate complex operational realities between deep technical engineering teams and customer-facing service personnel.

We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position.

The base pay range for this position is between $195,000 to $255,000 annually. Base pay will depend on multiple individualized factors including, but not limited to internal equity, job related knowledge, skills and experience.  This range represents a good faith estimate of compensation at the time of posting. Boston Dynamics offers a generous Benefits package including medical, dental vision, 401(k), paid time off and an annual bonus structure.  Additional details regarding these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer for employment.

description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is a global leader in materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every new chip and advanced display in the world. We design, build and service cutting-edge equipment that helps our customers manufacture display and semiconductor chips – the brains of devices we use every day. As the foundation of the global electronics industry, Applied enables the exciting technologies that literally connect our world – like AI and IoT. If you want to push the boundaries of materials science and engineering to create next generation technology, join us to deliver material innovation that changes the world. 

What We Offer

Salary:
$176,500.00 - $242,500.00

Location:
Santa Clara,CA

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits. 

About the Role

The Director, Product Portfolio & Product Lifecycle Transformation leads business and IT transformation initiatives that enable product lifecycle management, program governance, and portfolio value realization across a complex global enterprise environment. This role partners closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, and cross-functional organizations to drive integrated platform execution, business process improvement, and operational excellence across the end-to-end Idea-to-Retire lifecycle. The Director translates business priorities into scalable process and technology solutions that improve governance, visibility, and portfolio performance.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead transformation initiatives across product lifecycle, project and portfolio management, and related business process and IT platform capabilities

- Partner with business and IT stakeholders to define priorities, roadmaps, and execution plans aligned with organizational objectives

- Drive end-to-end execution of complex IT-enabled programs, including scope, milestones, dependencies, governance, risk management, and value realization

- Enable and improve end-to-end Idea-to-Retire business processes through integrated platforms, process standardization, and cross-functional alignment

- Provide leadership in product lifecycle, program governance, and portfolio management to strengthen planning, transparency, decision-making, and execution

- Lead implementation, integration, and optimization efforts involving Siemens PLM, SAP S/4, and related enterprise platforms

- Translate business requirements into scalable digital solutions that support product development, project resource management, and portfolio planning processes

- Establish governance mechanisms, execution cadences, and stakeholder engagement approaches that support delivery, adoption, and sustained business value

- Drive adoption of industry best practices and process harmonization across product and project portfolio management capabilities

- Lead cross-functional teams, program partners, and stakeholders through change management, issue resolution, and execution delivery

- Define, monitor, and report success measures, portfolio health indicators, and business value realization metrics for strategic programs.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field

- Significant experience in enterprise IT, digital transformation, product lifecycle management, ERP, or portfolio management environments

- Proven experience leading large-scale business process and IT transformation programs

- Strong stakeholder management experience across both business and IT organizations

- Experience with Siemens PLM, SAP S/4, or comparable enterprise platforms supporting product lifecycle and portfolio processes

- Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives with senior stakeholder visibility, multiple dependencies, and enterprise impact

- Strong communication, influencing, and change leadership skills

Preferred Qualifications

- Advanced degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field

- Experience in semiconductor, manufacturing, or other complex product-based global organizations

- Experience leading platform-enabled transformation across Idea-to-Retire processes

- Strong understanding of industry best practices in product and project portfolio management

- Experience building governance models and operating mechanisms that improve execution and business value realization

- Demonstrated success aligning technology solutions with business priorities and portfolio objectives

Functional Knowledge

- Product lifecycle, program governance, project and portfolio value realization through integrated IT platforms

- Product and project portfolio management business processes and platform enablement

- Product development and project resource management processes within complex enterprise environments

- Business process transformation and program execution leadership in IT implementation environments

- End-to-end Idea-to-Retire transformation enabled through integrated digital platforms

- Enterprise platforms such as Siemens PLM and SAP S/4

Additional Information

Time Type:
Full time

Employee Type:
Assignee / Regular

Travel:
Yes, 10% of the Time

Relocation Eligible:
No

For all sales roles, the posted salary range is the Target Total Cash (TTC) range for the role, which is the sum of base salary and target bonus amount at 100% goal achievement.

description:
Introduction to the Team & Role

 
What if your team was the one that got to build the future of how a company runs — and tried it on itself first?
 
GTM Systems owns the tech stack behind 360Learning's commercial engine — Salesforce, Marketo, data enrichment and AI tooling across sales, marketing, customer success and services. Our mission is to be a force multiplier for the business: making go-to-market faster, smarter and more effective.
 
We already have a high-performing team, mature systems, extensive documentation, and an ambitious AI vision. Now we need someone to build on that foundation and take it to the next level.
 
You'll work closely with GTM leaders, operators, data teams and engineering to turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, scalable products. You'll partner with each team to define the target state — where AI can take work off their plate, and where the human touch matters — then build the systems and agents that get them there.
 
This is a high-impact role for someone who loves working at the intersection of product, systems, AI and go-to-market strategy.
 

Key Responsibility Areas

  • Own the internal AI operating model for GTM — the library of skills, agent evals, cost, adoption and ROI — in partnership with Data and Enablement.
  • Keep the team a step ahead as customer zero for AI, turning what works into patterns other functions adopt.
  • Own the long-term design of the GTM stack — CRM, marketing automation, CS tooling — deciding what to build vs. buy.
  • Help the company prioritize by identifying the best solution to each business problem and sizing its cost and feasibility.
  • Lead and coach five senior ICs across Salesforce, marketing/BDR, CS systems and web ops. Set a high bar for documentation, testing and deployment — and hold it without slowing the team down.
  • Run vendor management end to end: evaluations, the quarterly keep-or-kill review, and renewals.
  • Partner as a peer to the leaders of Data, Enablement, Security, Finance and every commercial function.
  • Drive adoption and change management for new GTM capabilities across distributed teams.

What You'll Do
Within 1 month, you will:
  • Know the team, the stack, and the cross-functional leaders and teams you’ll partner with
  • Understand the main business challenges and opportunities for each GTM function
  • Own the team's current quarterly objectives and the routines that keep them visible.

    • Within 3 months, you will:
  • Have taken one major cross-functional change from plan to done
  • Own the full vendor-renewal cycle across the commercial stack
  • Have co-written the next quarter's objectives with the performance and enablement teams, each one stating the business problem, the current state, the expected impact and the plan.

    • Within 6 months, you will:
  • Have co-written the next quarter's objectives with the performance and enablement teams, each one stating the business problem, the current state, the expected impact and the plan.
  • Have shipped at least one AI agent that watches business data and reaches people on its own, with a named business owner and outcome measures agreed before launch.
  • Have a 12-18 month roadmap, setting the high-level vision across our systems infrastructure, ways of working, and AI portfolio

    • Within 12 months, you will:
  • Show, in numbers, the capacity the commercial organization reinvested because of what the team built.
  • Have a development path agreed with each member of the team.
  • Have the team recognized as the company's reference for AI-native operations

    • The Skill Set
  • 5+ years across GTM systems, agentic/AI workflow products, revenue technology, enterprise SaaS — or an adjacent path like technical product management or consulting where you designed and shipped real systems with a strong AI mandate. 
  • Turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, scalable tooling — you read a process, tell whether it's any good, spot where AI creates value, and judge when to automate (and when not to), across the full revenue engine.
  • Have fluency in modern GTM systems: Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, routing, attribution, lead-to-quote, billing or customer lifecycle tools. Deep Salesforce fluency is a strong plus.
  • Have built with modern AI tooling: agents, plugins or skills on top of LLMs, connectors to business systems, and evals that tell you whether an agent is good.
  • You define KPIs, run experiments, and use data to prioritize where to invest and to measure real impact on pipeline, conversion, efficiency and revenue.
  • You drive  strategic alignment and executive communication — conclusion first, tradeoffs named, complex topics made simple — and you drive change through to adoption.
  • Thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where the first version of the strategy has to be shaped, tested and improved quickly.
  • Run vendor evaluations end to end
  • Set and hold standards for documentation, testing and deployment without slowing the team down, and coach senior ICs with care.
  • Fluent English (US/UK) / B2 level or equivalent (FR).
  • Enthusiasm for our working environment explained here: https://bit.ly/Convexity360L

    • What We Offer
  • Compensation: Package includes base salary, a variable component and equity 📈
  • Benefits/Perks: Work From Home stipend, RTT, lunch vouchers, medical insurance, gym subscription, 1 month parental leave for the second parent. 
  • Balance: Flexible hours, full remote work possible anywhere in France 🏠
  • Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: We have 6 active ERGs including Mental Health, Environmental/Sustainability, Women, Parents, LGBTQIA2S+, and Ethnic Diversity. Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact 🤝
  • Corporate Social Responsibility: Review our CSR Charter: 360learning.com/blog/corporate-social-responsibility-charter 🌎🌏🌍
  • Culture: A framework that will help you make an impact - envision our way of working and our Convexity Culture: https://bit.ly/Convexity360L & find out more about the teams, product and processes https://bit.ly/42H1ggC 🚀👩🏻‍💻🏆

    • Interview Process
    1. Call with the Talent Acquisition Manager
    2. Discovery Interview with the Hiring Coach (VP of Operations)
    3. Case Study with the Hiring Coach and future Team
    4. Clarification Interview with Future Direct Reports
    5. Convexity Culture  Interview
    6. Offer!
    Get ready using our Knowledge Base: https://bit.ly/42H1ggC
     
    Who We Are
    360Learning enables companies to upskill from within by turning their experts into champions for employee, customer, and partner growth. With our LMS for collaborative learning, Learning & Development teams can accelerate upskilling with the help of internal experts instead of slow top-down training. 360Learning is the easiest way to onboard and upskill employees, train customer-facing teams, and enable customers and partners–all from one place.

    360Learning powers the future of work at 1,700 organizations. Founded in 2013, 360Learning has raised $240 million with 400+ team members across North America and EMEA.

    Learning Includes Everyone.
    In concert with our culture, 360Learning believes learning includes everyone and that means embracing the strengths of diversity, connectedness, and inclusion. Through conscientious efforts, our global footprint celebrates cultures, perspectives, and experiences from all over the world to support our platform that is built for all regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. Thus, 360Learning is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace, and we commit to continue this throughout our processes for recruitment, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion, and all other conditions and terms of employment. We want to learn from and with you!

title: Staff Tech Portfolio Manager
description:
Why Join GEICO?

At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.

 

Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide.

 

Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers.

Staff Tech Portfolio Manager, Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS)

About the Role

We are seeking a strategic and execution-focused Staff Tech Portfolio Manager to lead enterprise Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) programs that improve developer productivity, platform reliability, operational readiness, and business delivery. This role partners across Engineering, Architecture, Product, Security, Risk, Finance, Operations, and application teams to translate platform strategy into actionable roadmaps, measurable outcomes, and scalable execution.

Key Responsibilities

Lead cross-functional planning, prioritization, sequencing, and delivery for high-impact PaaS platform programs, ensuring alignment across platform services, consuming application teams, and enterprise priorities.

Define and manage platform roadmaps, dependencies, risks, milestones, adoption plans, governance checkpoints, and executive-level status reporting.

Partner with Engineering, Architecture, Security, Risk, Operations, and Finance to ensure platform investments support scalability, reuse, compliance, resiliency, cost efficiency, and measurable business value.

Establish and track platform KPIs, including adoption, reliability, developer experience, time-to-market, operational health, supportability, and cost efficiency.

Drive delivery excellence through agile, iterative, and outcome-oriented practices, ensuring programs are supported by clear documentation, adoption playbooks, readiness plans, and post-launch learning.

Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders by translating technical priorities, delivery tradeoffs, platform risks, and investment decisions into clear business outcomes.

Promote consistent platform consumption, standards, best practices, and change readiness across application teams and internal platform stakeholders.

Evaluate emerging platform technologies, automation capabilities, developer tools, and operational practices that improve delivery speed, reliability, and developer experience.

Qualifications

10+ years of experience leading enterprise technology, program management, or platform portfolios with ownership of complex, cross-functional initiatives.

Strong understanding of enterprise platform capabilities, including developer platforms, cloud infrastructure, shared services, APIs, container platforms, integration services, and core enterprise systems.

Demonstrated ability to partner with architecture and engineering leaders while maintaining a customer-, business-, and outcome-oriented perspective.

Proven track record delivering high-impact programs in ambiguous environments while managing dependencies, risks, stakeholders, and measurable outcomes.

Strong influence and communication skills, with the ability to align technical, business, security, compliance, and operations stakeholders.

Experience with agile, lean, and iterative delivery models applied to platform or enterprise-scale initiatives.

Ability to build and present executive-ready roadmaps, dashboards, adoption plans, and impact stories using tools such as PowerBI, Tableau, Jira, Aha!, or similar platforms.

Preferred Experience & Certifications

Experience with PaaS capabilities such as container platforms, messaging, workflow orchestration, API management, file exchange, databases, caching, identity, certificate management, monitoring, and infrastructure automation.

General Familiarity with Infrastructure and Platform services and their purpose like Kubernetes, Azure, AWS, Terraform, CI/CD platforms, observability tooling, and enterprise service management practices.

Preferred certifications include SAFe, PMP, PMI-PgMP, Certified Scrum Professional, cloud platform certifications, or relevant product/program management credentials.

 

Annual Salary
$115,000.00 - $230,000.00
The above annual salary range is a general guideline. Multiple factors are taken into consideration to arrive at the final hourly rate/ annual salary to be offered to the selected candidate. Factors include, but are not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations.

 
At this time, GEICO will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.

The GEICO Pledge:

Great Company: Protecting customers through life’s twists and turns with innovation and integrity.

Great Careers: Personalized development programs, mentorship, and certification assistance.

Great Culture: Inclusive and collaborative culture rooted in shared success.

Great Rewards: Competitive pay, benefits, and flexibility to support your well-being and future.

GEICO hires and promotes individuals solely on the basis of their qualifications for the job to be filled.

 

GEICO reasonably accommodates qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to receive equal employment opportunity and/or perform the essential functions of the job, unless the accommodation would impose an undue hardship to the Company. This applies to all applicants and associates. GEICO also provides a work environment in which each associate is able to be productive and work to the best of their ability. We do not condone or tolerate an atmosphere of intimidation or harassment. We expect and require the cooperation of all associates in maintaining an atmosphere free from discrimination and harassment with mutual respect by and for all associates and applicants.

description:
Chief Portfolio Engineer (Principal)

Company:
The Boeing Company

The Boeing Intelligence Systems Maverick portfolio is seeking a Chief Portfolio Engineer (Principal) to join our team in Herndon, VA.

 

This role plays a critical leadership role across multiple Intelligence Systems programs assuring quality engineering in design, build, delivery, issue and risk management of mission critical systems. This chief engineering position sets the vision and implements the strategies for sound engineering practices and processes for all portfolio programs. Intelligence Systems is a portfolio of classified programs within Boeing Space, Intelligence & Weapon Systems. 

 

The chief portfolio engineer will ensure all technical aspects of each program are executed properly including product definition, validation, software and systems engineering, design integration, test and evaluation, and certification for the Boeing team and all associated supplier work content.  The portfolio Chief Engineer will also develop multi-disciplined skills, model-based tools, and standardized processes to deliver engineering for mission products through the lifecycle of the programs.  The program chief engineers will also be direct reports to the Intelligence Systems Chief Engineer.

 

Position Responsibilities:

Provides the Engineering leadership to a team representing multiple skill areas, which may include internal and external resources and customers

Develops statement of work (SOW) to satisfy research and development, ongoing and new business requirements

Collaborates with program engineers and business development to identify new and follow on concepts that will expand product or services lines. Anticipates change and organizes processes and resources to proactively respond

Identifies performance metrics and ensures that work and project breakdown structure (WBS/PBS), schedule and resource loading is completed by the team.

Develops and communicates responsibility authority accountability (RAA) to define team members' roles and responsibilities

Collaborate with cross-functional teams (software, hardware, verification, test, integration, product management) to ensure architectural coherence and timely delivery

Incorporates lessons learned into strategic process improvements. Prepares and presents outcomes, assessments and corrective action initiatives to Boeing management

Create and maintain interface control documents (ICDs)

Develop and maintain system architecture artifacts that align with program objectives and stakeholder needs

Elicit, write, analyze, and manage system-level requirements throughout the development lifecycle

Produce and maintain Concept of Operations (ConOps) documents capturing operational scenarios, use cases, and stakeholder roles

 

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):

Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology (including Manufacturing Technology), Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry or non-US equivalent qualifications directly related to the work statement

This position requires an active TS/SCI clearance with a current and active Full Scope polygraph

9 or more years' related work experience or an equivalent combination of technical education and experience

7+ years of experience with software development and/or Information Systems architecture design and operations

Knowledge of and ability to lead key engineering boards and review processes.

Experience with design trade studies, risk assessments, and technical decision-making; capturing rationale and outcomes

Experience with Requirements Management best practices and traceability

Experience with system integrated testing and Verification / Validation processes

 

 Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):

Experience leading multi-disciplinary engineering teams

Strong Communication, Adaptability, Decision Making, Customer Focus, Integrated Systems, Engineering Analysis, and Requirements/Tracing skillset

Experience designing and delivering Information Technology systems or products

Experience in agile/sprint planning, reviews, and continuous improvement activities to support rapid development cadence

 

Conflict of Interest:

Successful candidates for this job must satisfy the Company’s Conflict of Interest (COI) assessment process

 

Drug Free Workplace:

Boeing is a Drug Free Workplace where post offer applicants and employees are subject to testing for marijuana, cocaine, opioids, amphetamines, PCP, and alcohol when criteria is met as outlined in our policies.

 

Pay & Benefits:

At Boeing, we strive to deliver a Total Rewards package that will attract, engage and retain the top talent.  Elements of the Total Rewards package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities. 

 

The Boeing Company also provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. 

 

The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

Pay is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.  

 

Summary pay range for Principal (Level 6): $210,800.00 - $285,200.00

Language Requirements:
Not Applicable

Education:
Bachelor's Degree or Equivalent

Relocation:
Relocation assistance is not a negotiable benefit for this position.

Export Control Requirement:
This position must meet U.S. export control compliance requirements. To meet U.S. export control compliance requirements, a “U.S. Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. §120.62 is required. “U.S. Person” includes U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.

Safety Sensitive:
This is not a Safety Sensitive Position.

Security Clearance:
This position requires an active Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) U.S. Security Clearance with an adjudicated Counterintelligence or Full Scope Polygraph (U.S. Citizenship Required). (A U.S. Security Clearance that has been active in the past 24 months is considered active.).

Visa Sponsorship:
Employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status.

Contingent Upon Award Program
This position is not contingent upon program award

Shift:
Shift 1 (United States of America)

title: ETF Portfolio Analytics Director, Vice President, State Street Investment Management
description:
Who we are looking for

 

The ETF Portfolio Analytics Director, Vice President, is part of the Global ETF Research team. The role is responsible for developing and delivering customized portfolio analytics that help clients understand how portfolios are constructed, where vulnerabilities may be present, and how different investment solutions can support specific portfolio objectives.

 

The position combines portfolio diagnostics, asset allocation research, analytical tool development, and client-specific investment analysis. It covers both proprietary and non-proprietary funds and evaluates products according to the role they may play within a broader portfolio.

The role has a specific focus on:

·         Customized portfolio analytics and portfolio construction insights,

·         Strategic and tactical asset allocation analysis across asset classes, regions, factors, and investment styles,

·         Assessment of portfolio vulnerabilities, including concentration, unintended exposures, diversification gaps, drawdown sensitivity, liquidity considerations, and other sources of risk,

·         Evaluation of how proprietary and non-proprietary funds may serve different portfolio roles, such as core exposure, diversification, risk mitigation, income, liquidity management, or targeted return enhancement,

·         Development and maintenance of scalable analytical tools, methodologies, and client-ready portfolio diagnostics,

·         Leadership, quality oversight, and development of junior team members.

 

As an ETF Portfolio Analytics Director, you will work closely with ETF specialists, investment strategists, sales teams, and other stakeholders across the State Street Investment Management organization. You will translate complex portfolio findings into clear, commercially relevant insights and collaborate with marketing, product, and investment teams to support client engagement and business priorities.

The successful candidate will combine strong investment judgment with quantitative and communication skills. They will be able to move from portfolio-level diagnosis to practical asset allocation considerations, explain the interaction between holdings and exposures, and identify how individual funds can contribute to a coherent portfolio solution.

 

Why this role is important to us

 

The team you will join is part of State Street Investment Management, one of the world's largest asset managers, serving governments, institutions, and financial advisors globally. With more than four decades of experience and trillions of dollars in assets under management, we offer a broad range of investment solutions across asset classes, risk profiles, regions, and investment styles. As pioneers in index investing and ETFs, we continue to develop new ways to help investors build portfolios.

Clients increasingly need analysis that goes beyond selecting an individual fund. They need to understand how exposures interact at the portfolio level, whether diversification is effective, where risk may be concentrated, and which implementation choices are most appropriate for their objectives and constraints. High-quality portfolio analytics can turn fund-level data into actionable portfolio construction insights and is an important capability supporting the growth of our ETF business.

Join us if you are ready to make an immediate impact by helping clients identify portfolio vulnerabilities, evaluate asset allocation choices, and use investment products more effectively within complete portfolios.

What you will be responsible for

 

Customized portfolio analytics and portfolio diagnostics:

·         Lead the design and delivery of customized analyses for client portfolios, model portfolios, and strategic sales opportunities,

·         Assess portfolio structure across asset classes, regions, sectors, factors, currencies, investment styles, and underlying holdings,

·         Identify potential vulnerabilities, including concentration risk, overlapping exposures, unintended factor tilts, diversification gaps, drawdown sensitivity, liquidity constraints, and dependence on individual market outcomes,

·         Apply scenario analysis, stress testing, risk decomposition, performance attribution, correlation analysis, and other relevant methods to explain portfolio behavior,

·         Translate analytical findings into clear observations, trade-offs, and implementation considerations for clients and internal stakeholders,

·         Produce the Portfolio Insights and Analysis output, providing an in-depth assessment of portfolio construction, areas of weakness, potential risk, and opportunities to improve portfolio resilience.

 

Asset allocation and portfolio construction strategies:

·         Evaluate strategic and tactical asset allocation approaches in the context of client objectives, investment horizons, risk tolerances, liquidity needs, and implementation constraints,

·         Analyze how changes in asset allocation may affect portfolio risk, return drivers, diversification, and sensitivity to market scenarios,

·         Develop analytical frameworks that connect macroeconomic and market views with portfolio exposures and possible implementation choices,

·         Assess the role of different building blocks within a total portfolio, including core beta, active, factor, fixed income, liquidity, income, alternatives, and risk-management exposures,

·         Support the development of portfolio construction methodologies, model-based analyses, and repeatable frameworks for common client use cases.

 

Fund roles and implementation analysis:

·         Evaluate both State Street and third-party funds according to their potential function within a portfolio,

·         Analyze how different funds may provide core exposure, diversification, downside mitigation, income, liquidity, inflation sensitivity, duration management, factor exposure, or targeted growth opportunities,

·         Assess implementation trade-offs using holdings, returns, risk, liquidity, portfolio fit, and other relevant characteristics,

·         Use competitive and market analysis selectively to frame available implementation choices and explain material differences between approaches,

·         Provide data and analysis for client requests, including holdings, return streams, portfolio characteristics, risk measures, exposure analysis, and other relevant outputs.

 

Analytical tool and methodology development:

·         Maintain and enhance existing portfolio analytics tools using in-house capabilities and third-party data or technology platforms,

·         Develop scalable tools that support both repeatable high-volume analysis and detailed bespoke work for significant commercial opportunities,

·         Create robust methodologies for portfolio diagnostics, vulnerability assessment, asset allocation analysis, fund-role classification, and implementation comparison,

·         Improve workflow efficiency, data quality, methodological consistency, and the clarity of client-ready outputs,

·         Evaluate relevant external analytical capabilities where they can strengthen portfolio analysis or improve the client experience.

 

Commercial and stakeholder support:

·         Partner with sales, ETF specialists, and investment strategists to understand client needs and define the most relevant analytical approach,

·         Design targeted portfolio analyses that support specific client conversations and commercial opportunities,

·         Serve as a subject matter expert for portfolio analytics, portfolio construction, asset allocation, and ETF-related RFPs and DDQs,

·         Present complex findings in a concise and accessible way for technical and non-technical audiences,

·         Collaborate with product, marketing, investment, and technology teams to align analytical capabilities with client needs and business priorities.

 

Leadership and quality oversight:

·         Train and develop junior team members in portfolio analytics, investment interpretation, tool usage, and communication of findings,

·         Allocate and prioritize work across the team, balancing recurring deliverables with bespoke client opportunities,

·         Review analytical outputs for methodological soundness, accuracy, relevance, and claritt,

·         Ensure deliverables are completed accurately and on time,

·         Promote consistent analytical standards, documentation, and effective knowledge sharing.

 

What we value

These skills will help you succeed in this role:

·         Excellent quantitative, portfolio analysis, and investment interpretation skills,

·         Strong understanding of portfolio construction, asset allocation, diversification, risk decomposition, scenario analysis, and performance drivers,

·         Ability to identify portfolio vulnerabilities and distinguish material risks from less decision-relevant observations,

·         Ability to evaluate funds as portfolio building blocks and explain how different exposures may serve different investor objectives,

·         Experience designing analytical frameworks, automating processes, and developing scalable tools,

·         Strong attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy when working under pressure,

·         Ability to prioritize work, exercise sound judgment, and meet tight deadlines,

·         Ability to communicate technical analysis clearly in writing, presentations, and client discussions,

·         Good understanding of the global ETF and fund landscape, investment implementation choices, and relevant distribution channels,

·         Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience extracting meaningful insights from large and complex data sets is essential,

·         Ability to guide less experienced team members and develop their analytical skills,

·         Collaborative, self-motivated, intellectually curious, and comfortable working independently,

 

Education and preferred qualifications

·         Bachelor's degree or equivalent; an advanced degree or relevant professional qualification is beneficial,

·         10+ years of experience in a financial institution or finance-related industry, with substantial exposure to portfolio analytics, asset allocation, investment research, or portfolio construction,

·         Strong written and spoken English.

 

Other beneficial skills

·         Working knowledge of Bloomberg, Morningstar, FactSet, or comparable investment analytics and data platforms,

·         Experience with ETFs, mutual funds, model portfolios, multi-asset portfolios, or institutional portfolio analysis,

·         Programming or data-handling skills relevant to scalable analytics,

·         Experience developing analytical solutions using AI or advanced automation tools,

·         Knowledge of investment risk, market structure, liquidity, and portfolio implementation considerations,

·         Awareness of current market and economic issues and their potential portfolio implications.

Minimum Salary:​

The minimum salary quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate ultimately works outside of this primary location, the applicable minimum salary may differ.​

Salary will be determined based on factors such as the position, type of work performed, individual skills, job description, working hours, diligence, initiative, self-management, length of employment, availability, and the quantity and quality of work delivered, as well as other objective and non-discriminatory criteria relevant to State Street employees.​

In addition to salary, employees are eligible to be considered for discretionary annual performance-based awards.​

​

We Offer:​

Additional holidays (Birthday Day Off, 3rd and 5th year anniversary Day Off)​

Gold Medical Package for employees and their families (partner and children)​

Premium life insurance package and private pension plan​

Variety of well-being programs​

Additional benefits available depending on the seniority of the role

title: Currency Management Portfolio Manager, Assistant Vice President
description:
Who we are looking for

State Street Currency Management is seeking a Currency Portfolio Manager to join our team in Sydney, Australia.

The Currency Portfolio Manager is central to the daily management and implementation of institutional client currency hedging strategies. The Portfolio Manager analyzes and monitors client portfolio exposures relative to current hedge positions across funds and share classes and is responsible for the end-to-end management of assigned client mandates.

The role requires a strong understanding of FX markets, portfolio management, risk and controls, and client servicing. The successful candidate will work closely with colleagues across our global Currency Management team to deliver consistent client outcomes and effective global coverage.

Why this role is important to us

The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Markets (SSM). When owners and managers of institutional assets need research, trading, securities lending and innovative portfolio strategies, they turn to the SSM business unit. As our investment research and trading arm, SSM’s number one goal is to enhance and preserve our clients’ portfolio values by applying technology, optimizing trading, and linking asset classes and markets across the world. Join us if making your mark in the capital markets industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

What you will be responsible for

As a Currency Portfolio Manager, you will:

Manage the daily implementation and oversight of currency hedging strategies for assigned institutional clients.

Monitor client portfolio exposures relative to current hedge positions and identify required rebalancing activity.

Ensure the completeness and accuracy of inbound client data, mandate compliance, portfolio calculations and client reporting.

Create and review FX orders, perform pre-trade due diligence and coordinate trade execution in accordance with client mandates.

Exercise sound judgment in managing client hedging programs, identifying potential data issues, mandate exceptions and operational risks, and escalating where appropriate.

Manage the full portfolio lifecycle, including rebalances and other client-directed or event-driven transactions.

Contribute to complex client events, including new client implementations, restructurings, and transitions

Perform post-trade review and ensure transactions and portfolio positions have been accurately reflected within Currency Management systems.

Monitor portfolio-level risks, including hedge ratios, currency exposures and client-specific mandate requirements.

Work closely with the global Currency Management team in Sydney, London and Boston to provide effective global coverage and seamless transition of responsibilities between regions.

Partner with trading colleagues on execution strategy, counterparty considerations and transaction-cost analysis where appropriate.

Participate in client due diligence meetings, service reviews, new-business presentations and ongoing client inquiries.

Contribute to enhancements to portfolio-management processes, controls, technology and monitoring capabilities.

Maintain a strong risk and control mindset, ensuring that portfolio-management activities are performed in accordance with established policies, procedures and client requirements.

Global Coverage: The role is based in Sydney, Australia and forms part of Currency Management's global portfolio-management coverage alongside colleagues in London and Boston.  The successful candidate must be comfortable managing responsibilities within a global operating model where client portfolios, instructions and issues may transition between regions. Clear communication, disciplined handovers, strong documentation and consistent adherence to portfolio-management controls are therefore critical to the role.

What we value

These skills will help you succeed in this role:

Demonstrated experience in currency portfolio management, FX markets, portfolio implementation or a related institutional investment-management function.

Strong understanding of FX products, particularly spot, forwards and swaps.

Experience managing institutional client portfolios or implementing hedging strategies.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to evaluate portfolio exposures, hedge positions and transaction requirements.

Excellent attention to detail and a demonstrated ability to operate accurately within time-critical deadlines.

Sound judgment and the ability to identify unusual data, portfolio or trading activity and escalate appropriately.

Strong understanding of investment-management risk and control principles.

Ability to communicate effectively with institutional clients and internal stakeholders.

Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a global team.

Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to process and control improvements.

Genuine interest in financial markets, currencies and institutional portfolio management.

Education & Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering or another quantitative discipline.

CFA designation or progress toward the CFA is preferred.

Relevant experience within institutional asset management, currency management, investment operations or global markets.

Experience with FX trading and portfolio-management platforms is beneficial.

Knowledge of transaction-cost analysis and execution-quality monitoring is advantageous.

description:
Über Rotzinger Transver

Rotzinger Transver mit Standorten in Kaiseraugst und Altendorf in der Schweiz ist ein führender Anbieter von Lösungen für Produktflusssteuerung, Pufferung, Verteilung und Fördertechnik für die Lebensmittel-, Süsswaren- und Verpackungsindustrie.

Unser Portfolio umfasst eine breite Palette innovativer Systeme, die eine zuverlässige Produkthandhabung, eine stabile Linienleistung sowie eine effiziente Verbindung zwischen Verarbeitungs- und Verpackungsprozessen gewährleisten. Mit modularen, skalierbaren und hygienischen Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, Produktverluste zu reduzieren, Stillstandszeiten zu minimieren und die Gesamtanlageneffektivität (OEE) zu steigern. Wir sind bestrebt, unser Angebot und unsere Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, um den sich wandelnden Anforderungen unserer Kunden gerecht zu werden.

Weitere Informationen über Rotzinger Transver und unser umfassendes Leistungsspektrum finden Sie auf der Website: www.rotzingertransver.com.

Rotzinger Transver ist Teil von Coesia, einer weltweit tätigen Unternehmensgruppe für innovative Industrie- und Verpackungslösungen mit Hauptsitz in Bologna. Coesia ist in 34 Ländern vertreten, vereint 21 Unternehmen und beschäftigt per 2026 mehr als 8'000 Mitarbeitende weltweit.

Über die Rolle

Als Head of Project Management (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für das Projektportfolio an unseren Produktionsstandorten in Kaiseraugst und Altendorf. Sie führen ein Team von Project Managern und sorgen für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung unserer internationalen Kundenprojekte. Dabei treiben Sie die Weiterentwicklung des Projektmanagements aktiv voran und tragen dazu bei, Projekte effizienter, transparenter und profitabler umzusetzen.

  • Führung und Weiterentwicklung des PMO-Teams über beide Standorte hinweg

  • Steuerung und Priorisierung des Projektportfolios in Abstimmung mit den Unternehmenszielen

  • Sicherstellung der erfolgreichen Umsetzung komplexer Kundenprojekte hinsichtlich Qualität, Kosten und Termine

  • Aktives Management von Risiken, Änderungen und Projektprofitabilität

  • Überwachung relevanter KPIs und Förderung kontinuierlicher Verbesserungen

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Sales und Service

  • Weiterentwicklung von Projektmanagement-Standards, Prozessen und Methoden

  • Professionelles Stakeholder- und Kundenmanagement über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus


Was Sie mitbringen

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektmanagement sowie Führungserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Rolle

  • Erfahrung in der erfolgreichen Leitung komplexer Kundenprojekte

  • Erfahrung im Maschinen- und Anlagenbau oder einem vergleichbaren industriellen Umfeld

  • Technischer Hochschulabschluss oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Unternehmerisches Denken und ein gutes Verständnis für Kosten, Margen und Projektprofitabilität

  • Projektmanagement-Zertifizierungen wie PMP oder IPMA von Vorteil

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations-, Führungs- und Veränderungskompetenzen

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

  • Reisebereitschaft zwischen den Standorten sowie zu internationalen Kunden (ca. 20–30 %)

  • Vergünstigungen beim Fahrzeugkauf

  • Dienstjubiläums- und Treueprämien

  • Unterstützung bei Aus- und Weiterbildungen

Job Title:

Job Description:

The Role:

Entegris is seeking a Senior Director, Enterprise Portfolio Management Office (EPMO) to lead portfolio governance, demand management, and delivery oversight for strategic technology and digital transformation initiatives. 

This leader will partner closely with business and technology executives to ensure investments are aligned to company priorities, appropriately funded and resourced, and delivered in a predictable manner. This leader will establish the processes and governance required to move initiatives efficiently from idea through execution and value realization while driving transparency, accountability, and business outcomes across the portfolio. 

The ideal candidate combines strong portfolio and program leadership experience with the ability to influence executive decision-making, lead organizational change, and improve the effectiveness of enterprise technology investments. 

This position reports directly to the Chief Information & Digital Officer. It will be based local to one of our hubs, ideally in Chaska, MN, Bedford, MA, or Aurora, IL.

 

What You’ll Do:

Enterprise Portfolio Leadership & Governance

Lead the Enterprise Portfolio Management Office (EPMO), establishing portfolio management, governance, and delivery practices that enable successful execution of strategic initiatives.

Oversee enterprise portfolio governance, prioritization, funding, and investment decision-making to ensure alignment with business objectives and organizational capacity.

Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on portfolio strategy, investment priorities, risks, and tradeoffs.

Demand Management & Portfolio Prioritization

Own the enterprise demand management process, providing a transparent framework for evaluating, prioritizing, and approving technology and digital investments.

Lead the end-to-end portfolio lifecycle from intake and business case development through execution and value realization.

Develop portfolio metrics and reporting that provide visibility into demand, capacity, delivery performance, and investment outcomes.

Resource Planning & Portfolio Optimization

Lead enterprise-wide capacity planning and resource forecasting to balance demand, funding, and organizational readiness.

Facilitate executive decision-making regarding investment priorities, resource allocation, and portfolio tradeoffs.

Continuously evaluate portfolio performance and recommend adjustments to maximize business value and delivery effectiveness.

Strategic Program Oversight

Provide executive oversight for large-scale, cross-functional technology and business transformation initiatives.

Ensure effective risk management, governance, financial stewardship, and delivery

Executive Reporting & Value Realization

Provide executive leadership with a consolidated view of portfolio performance, investment health, risks, and realized business value.

Establish value realization measures and drive continuous improvement across portfolio management, governance, and delivery practices.

Organizational Leadership & PMO Maturity

Lead, develop, and inspire a high-performing team of portfolio management professionals.

Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement while advancing portfolio management capabilities across the enterprise.

Champion organizational change management and PMO best practices to improve adoption, efficiency, and business outcomes.

What We Seek:

Demonstrated success leading an Enterprise PMO, Portfolio Management Office, or comparable function within a complex global organization.

Extensive experience managing strategic technology portfolios, enterprise transformation initiatives, and portfolio governance processes.

Strong expertise in demand management, prioritization, resource planning, investment management, and value realization.

Deep understanding of portfolio, program, project, Agile, and product delivery methodologies.

Proven ability to influence executive decision-making and build strong partnerships across business and technology functions.

Strong business and financial acumen, including business case development, budgeting, forecasting, and investment planning.

Demonstrated success leading organizational change, improving operating models, and driving measurable business outcomes.

Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Broad understanding of enterprise business processes and supporting technologies across key functional areas.

Outstanding Candidates Will Have:

Master's degree in business administration, Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.

10+ years of progressive leadership experience in portfolio, program, or project management.

Experience leading enterprise portfolios and large-scale digital or business transformation initiatives.

Experience transforming PMO organizations and advancing portfolio management maturity.

Relevant certifications such as PMP, PgMP, PfMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, or equivalent.

Demonstrated track record of delivering measurable business value through technology investments and operational excellence.

Lead. Inspire. Innovate. Define Your Future.

Not everyone who works for a global company shares the same background, experiences and perspectives. We leverage the differences of our employees to bring new ideas to the table. Every employee throughout the company is encouraged to share input on projects and initiatives. We put our values at the core of how we operate as an organization — not just when it’s convenient, but in a lasting and meaningful way. We want the time and energy you spend here to have a positive impact on your life inside and outside of the office.
